## About
Bill Jones Auto Parts & Perez Used Cars, Inc. sits on South Central Expressway in Dallas, serving the area with quality used parts for cars and trucks.
Come up to the front counter, tell us what you are looking for, and we will help you track down the correct part. Neighbors keep coming back for good parts at good prices and staff who treat them right.

## Services
- Quality used parts: Good used parts at fair prices, with help from the counter to find what fits.
- Parts for cars and trucks: We carry parts for cars and trucks alike.

## FAQ
Q: Do your parts come with a warranty?
A: Yes. Parts come with a standard 90 day warranty.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: No, we are closed on Sunday. We are open Monday through Saturday.

Q: What if I am not sure which part I need?
A: Ask at the counter. Reviewers say the staff is very helpful in finding the correct part.
